title: Instant Pot Duo vs Duo Plus: Which One Should You Buy?
h1: Instant Pot Duo vs Duo Plus
metaDescription: Instant Pot Duo or Duo Plus? Compare functions, display and value to choose the right 6-quart pressure cooker.
lede: The Duo and Duo Plus cook the same way and use the same recipes. The difference is in extra programs and the display.

data.verdict: Most people should buy the Duo: it does everything that matters for everyday pressure cooking. Choose the Duo Plus if you want the extra programs and a display that shows each cooking stage.

productA.name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 6-Qt Electric Pressure Cooker

productB.name: Instant Pot Duo Plus 9-in-1 6-Qt Electric Pressure Cooker
productB.bestFor: people who want more presets and a clearer display
productB.blurb: The 9-in-1 upgrade with a progress display.

p: Recipes, accessories and inner pots are broadly shared between the two 6-quart models, so you won't miss out on anything by choosing the Duo.
If the price difference is small when you shop, the Duo Plus display is a nice quality-of-life upgrade.
